questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: The Finance Commission is constituted under which Article?
questions.explanation: Article 280 provides for the constitution of the Finance Commission by the President.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: Who founded the Self-Respect Movement in Tamil Nadu?
questions.explanation: E.V. Ramasamy, popularly known as Periyar, founded the Self-Respect Movement.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Swadeshi Movement began as a protest against which event?
questions.explanation: The Swadeshi Movement began in response to the Partition of Bengal in 1905.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Which river is known as the Dakshin Ganga?
questions.explanation: The Godavari is often called the Dakshin Ganga because of its length and importance in peninsular India.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Which soil is most suitable for cotton cultivation?
questions.explanation: Black soil, also called regur soil, is highly suitable for cotton cultivation.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Which vitamin is mainly synthesized in the human skin on exposure to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight, especially UV-B radiation, helps the skin synthesize Vitamin D.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is:
questions.explanation: The ampere is the SI base unit of electric current.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: Repo rate is the rate at which:
questions.explanation: The repo rate is the rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks against securities.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: Which institution issues currency notes in India except the one-rupee note?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India issues banknotes except the one-rupee note and coins, which are issued by the Government of India.

questions.subject: Tamil Nadu
questions.question: What is the state animal of Tamil Nadu?
questions.explanation: The Nilgiri tahr is the state animal of Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: Tamil Nadu
questions.question: The ancient port city of Kaveripoompattinam was also known as:
questions.explanation: Kaveripoompattinam was also known as Puhar, an important Chola port city.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: If 20% of a number is 50, what is the number?

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: A train travels 120 km in 2 hours. Its average speed is:
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance ÷ time = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 km/h.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: The simple interest on ₹1,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years is:

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: What is the next number in the series 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
questions.explanation: Each term is doubled, so 24 × 2 = 48.

questions.subject: Current Affairs Basics
questions.question: Which body conducts the Civil Services Examination in India?
questions.explanation: The Union Public Service Commission conducts the Civil Services Examination.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.question: Which gas is the largest contributor to anthropogenic global warming by total emissions?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the dominant long-lived greenhouse gas emitted by human activities.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.question: Project Tiger was launched in India in:
questions.explanation: Project Tiger was launched in 1973 to conserve tiger populations and habitats.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: 'யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்' என்ற வரிகளைப் பாடியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: 'யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்' என்பது கணியன் பூங்குன்றனாரின் புகழ்பெற்ற புறநானூறு பாடல் வரி.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: திருக்குறளை இயற்றியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: திருக்குறளை இயற்றியவர் திருவள்ளுவர்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: 'சிலப்பதிகாரம்' நூலின் ஆசிரியர் யார்?
questions.explanation: சிலப்பதிகாரத்தை இளங்கோ அடிகள் இயற்றினார்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: தமிழின் உயிரெழுத்துகள் எத்தனை?
questions.explanation: தமிழில் 12 உயிரெழுத்துகள் உள்ளன.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The national aquatic animal of India is:
questions.explanation: The Ganges river dolphin is India's national aquatic animal.
